programs.title: Brian Cox: How The Other Half Live
programs.desc: Part two of two. The actor continues to explore society's complicated relationship with money and wealth, this time turning the lens onto his adopted country of America. He wants to find out whether the American Dream - that anyone can make it big if they work hard enough - is a myth or a reality. In Miami, Brian meets Caroline, a highly successful 'influencer', who's posing for a photo shoot. He also reveals how he came to America, believing it to be the land of opportunity, but now he's not so sure.
